Chapter 778: Chapter 5: Ninth-Level Citizen (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Chapter 778: Chapter 5: Ninth-Level Citizen (Seeking Subscriptions)_3

Once, a supreme being from a different species was willing to exchange an eleven-star top-tier rare treasure for a chance to bathe in the Eternal Spring, to be used on their clan’s younger generation.

Human civilization did not agree.

An eleven-star top-tier rare treasure is worth tens of millions of Merit Points.

It was indeed a very sincere offer.

Human civilization refused, not because the eleven-star top-tier rare treasure was insufficient, but because there were more considerations.

Within human civilization, besides obtaining a chance to bathe upon ascending to Ninth Rank, if one wanted an additional bath, it would cost five million Merit Points per time.

...

Now, ascending to Ninth-Level Citizen, the three complimentary opportunities to bathe in the Eternal Spring are equivalent to fifteen million Merit Points.

“There’s a chance to let both Primordial Spirits take a dip.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that such opportunities to enhance the potential of the flesh were rare.

“There’s also the privilege of enjoying the exchange discounts from the Human Civilization Treasury…”

“The discount for exchanging civilization coins and Cosmic Crystals is sixty percent.”

“The discount for exchanging Merit Points is ninety percent…”

Lin Yuan was overjoyed.

So-called civilization coins and Cosmic Crystal exchanges are the regular and strategic resource exchanges in the Human Civilization Treasury.

They can be obtained through civilization coins and Cosmic Crystals.

When Lin Yuan was an Eighth-Level Citizen, he also enjoyed corresponding discounts, but at that time, it was eighty percent.

Now that he has ascended to a Ninth-Level Citizen, he directly benefits from a sixty percent exchange rate, a reduction of twenty percent, no one knows how many Cosmic Crystals it can help Lin Yuan save.

As for the discount on exchanging Merit Points…

Every Merit Point exchange in the Human Civilization Treasury is a limited resource, even not open to outsiders.

This includes many twelve-star rare treasures, many special heritage sites, and places like the black planet that are useful for comprehending and amalgamating rules.

Even though the discount on Merit Points exchange is only ten percent, what is being saved is Merit Points, and the rare treasures that are exchanged are extremely rare in the entire Cosmic Starry Sky.

“With a ten percent discount… as long as I exchange for one hundred billion Merit Points worth of rare treasures, I can make up for the Merit Points spent on my ascension to a Ninth-Level Citizen in one stroke.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; this was the effect of elevating the level of citizenship, the short-term gain might not be the greatest, but looking at the long term, the benefits were sure to be extensive and profound.

…

The privileges and advantages of ascending to a Ninth-Level Citizen are countless, indeed numbering in the thousands.

Lin Yuan briefly went through them, most of which were enhanced versions of those available to Eighth-Level Citizens, and the remaining new privileges were equally helpful to him.

At the very least, it could save him from many troublesome periods.

…

“Merit Points needed to ascend to Tenth-Level Citizen…”

After looking through many privileges, Lin Yuan looked towards the conditions for ascending to a Tenth-Level Citizen.

“Fifty billion Merit Points?”

Lin Yuan’s mouth twitched slightly, such a massive amount of Merit Points, even if he converted all the strange objects from the Two-dimensional World, it would still be far from enough.

“Now, aside from the nine Supreme Beings in human civilization, there probably aren’t many citizens who are Tenth-Level or higher, right?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, even for an Eleventh-Rank Evolver, amassing fifty billion Merit Points was nearly an impossible feat.

Unless one could slaughter their way through a Large Alien Battlefield, it wasn’t even worth considering.

And slaughter through a Large Alien Battlefield? Even for the Four Divine Kings at their peak, it was hard to achieve as Supreme Beings could enter the fray at any moment.

And even if Supreme Beings didn’t intervene, the Eleventh-Rank Peak powerhouses from the Peak Clans were not so easy to deal with; with supreme weapons in hand, if you can’t overcome one, you would have to face five or ten.

In such circumstances, who could withstand that?

Nowadays, the Tenth-Level Citizens of human civilization are mostly Eleventh-Rank Evolvers from universities, or those human citizens who have made significant contributions during the long dormant years before the Starry Sea Era.

…

“Purchase resources, and continue cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’.”

Lin Yuan opened the Human Civilization Treasury and began selecting his choices.

The ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ is one of the three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Profound Yellow Lineage, divided into four levels: Entry, Minor Achievement, Major Achievement, and Perfection.

Of course, these four levels are aimed at each Rank.

When at Ninth Rank, cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to the level of Perfection, and then advancing to Tenth Rank, when the level of life significantly leaps ahead, the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ will fall to Major Achievement or even Minor Achievement.

Theoretically, if a Twelfth Rank Ultimate Being can cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to perfection at their Rank stage, they can easily survive the great cosmic destruction.

To know, if a cosmos enters a period of great destruction, and all things collapse, even a Supreme Being could survive only half or even less.

Only Supreme Beings who have lived through the cosmic great destruction can be considered truly free.

Lin Yuan has already cultivated the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to Major Achievement, just one step away from Perfection.

Given Lin Yuan’s foundational physical strength, a Tenth Rank Level ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ perfected, his physique is already powerful enough to suppress rules, and just with his physical body, he could rival the second-tier Eleventh Rank.

“It’s about time.”

After selecting for a while, Lin Yuan spent about two hundred billion Cubic Universe Crystals, and after the sixty percent privilege of a Ninth-Level Citizen, he only paid out one hundred and twenty billion Cubic Universe Crystals.

He directly saved eighty billion Cubic Universe Crystals.

“The cost is really high.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

It’s not actually that the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ is expensive.

Indeed, the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ demands high resources, but the cost of cultivating the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ at only the Tenth Rank Level, however high it may be, is finite.

Mainly because Lin Yuan’s foundational physique is too strong, leading to a very high starting point, with the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ enhancing the physical strength tenfold.

If the initial physical strength of a normal Tenth Rank Life is ten, a tenfold increase would be one hundred.

With an initial physical strength of one hundred, a tenfold increase would be one thousand.

The resources spent on both are naturally different, and Lin Yuan’s initial physical strength is far more than one hundred, perhaps ten thousand, one hundred thousand, one million!

Therefore, the resources needed to cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to the Perfection level are naturally millions or even millions of times the normal amount.
